title: Sum, Difference, Product
description:
Ask for two numbers. Print their sum, then their difference, then their product — each on a separate line.

**Inputs:** `12`, then `4`

**Expected output:**
```
16
8
48
```
starterCode:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())
# Print sum, difference, product
hint: Three print statements: print(a + b), print(a - b), print(a * b)
